fields.label: Confidence interval (%)
fields.help: Confidence interval % for CT and reg_CI (ricp DEFAULT_CI).

fields.label: Target points per cloud
fields.help: Registration subsample size per cloud (count-based), or 'auto' for SPACING-DRIVEN: the same registration spacing (~2x the coarser native) is requested for both clouds, verified, and hard-capped at 1.5M pts. Minimum 2000.

fields.label: ICP max iterations
fields.help: Max inner ICP iterations per level (ricp DEFAULT_ICP_MAX_ITER).

fields.label: ICP variant
fields.help: point-to-plane (tighter on terrain) or classic point-to-point.

fields.label: Coarse mode
fields.help: auto = SCENE-style top-view correlation (no user interaction, but falls back to the GUI if placement quality is poor); gui = manual pick + nudge tool; none = clouds already roughly placed. IGNORED by the 'register' action, which always uses the supplied coarse transform.

fields.label: Quick coarse 'tx ty tz yaw_deg'
fields.help: Quick coarse transform as four numbers (overrides coarse mode). Empty = not passed.

fields.label: Coarse grid cell (m)
fields.help: Top-view grid cell size in metres for auto coarse. Empty = automatic (ricp default None).

fields.label: Skip tilt fit
fields.help: Skip the DEM-difference roll/pitch estimation that runs after coarse placement.

fields.label: Max tilt (deg)
fields.help: Sanity bound in degrees for the tilt fit (the fit self-validates; this only rejects the physically absurd).

fields.label: Overlap crop radius
fields.help: Common-overlap crop radius in metres after coarse placement: 'auto' = 10x point spacing, 'off' = disable, or a number.

fields.label: Equivalence margin (m)
fields.help: Practical-equivalence margin in metres for level selection, look-ahead and polish acceptance; 'auto' = max(2.5% of the best held-out J, 2 mm). Set from your application tolerance when one exists.

fields.label: Sigma floor (m)
fields.help: Floor in metres for the robust ICP residual scale (~2x sensor noise; sensor-dependent). Must be > 0.

fields.label: Skip polish pass
fields.help: Skip the final high-density polish ICP pass.

fields.label: Validate swap (reverse run)
fields.help: Also register in the reverse direction and report the composition error - a directional-bias diagnostic. Roughly doubles runtime.

fields.label: Swap max levels
fields.help: Level budget for the reverse (swap) validation. Empty = same as max levels, so the diagnostic is strictly symmetric.

fields.label: Cycle tolerance (m)
fields.help: Cycle-consistency tolerance in metres for validate-swap. Empty = auto (0.5x the common registration spacing).

fields.label: Cycle experiment
fields.help: DECISIVE directional diagnostic (replaces the plain swap): one frozen common-overlap mask at the final pose, density parity enforced, then forward and reverse on exactly the same two subsets. Roughly doubles runtime.
